verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev shows agent-specific durability primitives (durable multi-turn AI chats, tool() calls with needsApproval that pause/resume runs, agent skills for AI coding assistants) and markets itself for 'rock solid agents and AI applications,' which supports the theme, but the evidence never names concrete first-party wrapper packages for specific AI SDKs (e.g. Vercel AI SDK, LangChain) or model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic) that eliminate glue code — the integration is more that you build tasks around AI calls yourself. Missing for 10: named first-party SDK/provider integration packages, evidence of zero-glue-code wrapping for a named agent framework, independent confirmation of such integrations working end-to-end.
